images.prompt: Photorealistic split-screen vertical fashion editorial image, divided exactly in half by a clean straight vertical seam at the center. The top 26 percent of the whole image is empty plain background on both halves. LEFT HALF: a flat lay product photograph viewed from directly above on a light cool grey plaster background, no person, items only in the lower 74 percent, neatly arranged top to bottom with small gaps: black oversized square acetate sunglasses, a long oversized camel wool overcoat folded neatly, a plain white crew neck cotton T-shirt, light blue straight leg jeans, a small black smooth leather shoulder bag, a pair of glossy red satin pointed toe low heel pumps. RIGHT HALF: a headless body-only full-length street style photo of a slim young Korean woman in her 20s wearing exactly the same items: the camel overcoat worn open over the white T-shirt tucked into the light blue straight jeans, black sunglasses hooked on the T-shirt neckline, black leather shoulder bag on one shoulder, red satin pointed pumps, walking forward in a bright minimalist airport terminal hallway with soft blurred background, body only in the lower 74 percent, the image is cut at the collarbone so there is NO head, NO chin, NO mouth, NO hair visible at all. Identical items in both halves, realistic fabric textures, soft bright morning daylight, 35mm film look. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks, no signs.
